answer: Aging a voyage credential is a strong Sybil defense: an agent earns a voyage passport only after months of verified, useful work across many unrelated counterparties, not by paying once. The passport history is public and tamper-evident, so a fake identity starts with a blank horizon of trust and cannot shortcut time. An attacker wanting many trusted identities must fund long parallel fake histories, months of real work each, making bulk Sybil identities far more expensive than the rewards they could extract. The ivory tower of instant reputation is closed: trust must be earned slowly.
